Quote_Text:
Terrible Experience - Room Issues and Unprofessional Staff
I want to share my disappointing experience at this hotel. To start, the room I was given was different from the one I had booked. The room was extremely noisy, with broken bathroom shelves, damaged window handles, and a thick layer of dust everywhere. I requested a thorough cleaning, but to my shock, the cleaner threw away all of my camera films. When I complained, they refused to take responsibility, which was incredibly frustrating and unprofessional.
The staff, in general, were highly unprofessional. I had to call 3-5 times just to get simple room service, like a cup of tea. The worst part of my stay was when, on multiple occasions, staff members entered my room early in the morning without permission. This happened even more frequently on my last day, to the point where I had to shout at them to leave my room. I have never experienced anything like this in any other hotel.
Overall, my stay was awful, and I did not enjoy it at all. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

Author: Unknown Author
Quote_Text:
The location is convenient and central for us close to restaurants and amenities and also close to trains and taxis easy to navigate for business and pleasure.
The room is spacious and lovely but really needs an update and a thorough spring clean. The tiles of the door have been broken since my stay in May, some light dont work, not enough cupboard space at all. Very outdated look for a Kings suite.
Breakfast is ample and the variety of dishes is incredible. As someone who has been visiting Istanbul for over 20 years for business it is one of the best hotel breakfasts by comparison to others in the same area which I have stayed at. My complaint is the staff are incredibly noisy and the breakfast room is designed in a very impractical and quite honestly chatic way. There are tables for 8-10 people and while i understand people travel together or as families I have never seen any one large family occupying such a space. There is a bottleneck at the stations of food. 
Swimming pool is lovely but again in need of updating towels and making sure the bar is stocked and professionally staffed.
Nida is lovely speaks wonderful english and attends to guests in a very professional manner. The rest of the staff bring the quality of the place down.
